messages.subject: Sample dataframe with dplyr
parts:
I want to sample a dataframe repeatedly with dplyr and store the results in a dataframe. I asked the question on Stack Overflow (http://stackoverflow.com/questions/28629317/repeatedly-sample-a-data-frame-with-dplyr) and received an answer. But, although the code in the answer works, it seems to me a little bit clumsy.

I'm wondering if anyone on here has any alternative solutions?
